plan.after_each_request: Complete durable proof_barrier before admitting next graph; no parallel submission, retries or extra fills.

budget.write_allowance_status: Conservative provisional ceiling; exact cache/other-output bound review and fresh measured storage admission still required.

capture_contract.prewrite: Exact full F32 shape/dtype/finite/active-request checks before mkdir/save; no setup or placeholder capture roles.

claims.audio: Retain separate untouched raw outputs; no trim/resample/crossfade/concatenation.
claims.timing: Future submit-to-complete and anchor-ready-to-next-ready include conditioning/verification; no independent-W2 rate borrowed.

plan.first_conditioned_admission: After first-native proof; new encoding memory admission before pass0 chunk1 stages; accepted complete conditioned proof before subsequent conditioned requests.

LTXContinuationAnchor111.authority: Resolve only active exact request and its accepted immediate same-pass predecessor proof; no caller path/hash.
LTXContinuationAnchor111.cache: No cross-request cached provider output; one owned IMAGE shared by both consumers inside current request.
LTXContinuationAnchor111.output: Owned contiguous CPU F32 [1,384,640,3] from predecessor frame48; no conversion; reread whole-capture SHA each request.
LTXContinuationAnchor111.source_binding: Future sealed111 manifest must bind provider wrapper and reviewed anchor helper hashes.

LTXContinuationCondition111.authority: Bind run_name to active request; require supplied image is the exact guard-owned anchor object; A then B once each.
LTXContinuationCondition111.call: Use guard.run_stage(stage, request_id=run_name, vae=vae, latent=latent, native_call=exact_native_execute); same original kwargs strength1/bypassFalse.
LTXContinuationCondition111.safety: Fresh conditioning admission and encode OOM-to-tiled refusal required before either native call; no fallback.
LTXContinuationCondition111.source_binding: Future sealed111 manifest must bind wrapper and ConditioningStageGuard helper hashes.

numerical_contract.audio: raw outputs unchanged; timeline unresolved; no trim/resample/crossfade/concatenation

mandatory_runtime_policy.policy: Verify actual settings and tensors; never cast or change settings to satisfy this contract.
mandatory_runtime_policy.vae_encoder_route: unchanged native encode only; no tiled or alternate fallback

numerical_contract.output_arithmetic: unchanged110 except disclosed native conditioning before both samplers

Warm natural daylight, realistic wood texture, consistent lighting, no camera movement. Quiet water gently laps against the boat.
numerical_contract.reference_mode: sequential native image-conditioned continuation plus full-chain replay

every_chunk: exact registered graph and request/prompt/source identity
whole capture SHA and immediate same-pass predecessor linkage
conditioned chunks require provider and A/B exact-call receipts
proof_contract.final: Six per-chunk proofs, four anchor/consumption links, two setup verdicts, source/plan/runtime identity, final quiescence and no fault.
proof_contract.replay: All four tensors equal corresponding pass0 chunk; pass1 derives anchors only from its own proven predecessor.

provider_binding.context_plan_sha256: Use actual outer plan_sha256, never prototype_numerical_design_sha256 or qualification_id.
provider_binding.context_runtime_sha256: Use actual sealed111 runtime manifest, not source110 manifest or caller input.
provider_binding.dynamic_state: Only verified per-chunk proof table changes; all eight graph hashes stay fixed.
provider_binding.retention: Keep both complete chains and all anchor/consumption/proof metadata until no readers remain and replay plus seam review complete.
